title: Comparison of anomaly detection and supervised learning for acute myeloid leukemia blast identification: A proof-of-concept study
summary: This retrospective AML flow-cytometry study compares supervised, anomaly-detection and clustering approaches for blast identification and reports markedly different performance by prevalence, including two independent external validation samples. It qualifies narrowly as a clinical diagnostic-validation result.
ai_technology: Four anomaly detectors, Random Forest and UMAP-HDBSCAN are compared for blast identification using flow-cytometry features.
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material

evidence.tested: External check uses two independent samples only; results support a small proof-of-concept diagnostic comparison, not general clinical performance or clinical benefit.
evidence.unknown: External replication and real-world or clinical benefit were not established by the reviewed study; author affiliation is not stated in the reviewed material.
